item.text:
<linkedin_post>For people being screened for tuberculosis, the time between an X-ray and follow-up testing can determine whether several visits are needed to move toward a diagnosis.

At South Africa’s Mponeng Gold Mine, portable X-ray equipment and offline AI allow miners to be screened underground. Those whose images suggest TB can be referred for confirmatory molecular testing in the same visit, rather than waiting through a process that can take weeks.

The setting matters: deep-shaft miners face chronic silica dust exposure and an elevated risk of lung disease. Bringing screening to them also reduces the distance between identifying a possible case and arranging the next test.</linkedin_post>
